purpose: Generated target concepts for our original Singapore open-world game; not runtime captures

prompts.foot: Create an original AAA video-game visual target concept, landscape 16:9, extremely high detail and photoreal contemporary real-time 3D, aspirational visual fidelity comparable to the finest modern open-world games. This is OUR original Singapore open-world game, not an existing game screenshot. No existing franchise characters, logos or UI. Scene 1: third-person ON-FOOT GAMEPLAY CAMERA, clear full body original adult player at lower center-left, viewed from behind at human eye height, charcoal short-sleeve overshirt, slate trousers, realistic anatomy, walking into a busy Singapore-inspired neighborhood. A small coherent district: on left beautifully detailed two-/three-storey Peranakan shophouses in weathered ivory, dusty turquoise and muted coral, terracotta pitched roofs, carved shutters, recessed doors and continuous shaded five-foot-way arcade; on right a red-truss open-sided hawker hall with actual stalls, metal counters, ceiling fans, occupied tables, yellow stools, warm practical lights, broad canopy rain trees. Beyond are recognizable HDB-inspired residential blocks with void decks, balconies and sheltered links, with distant glass waterfront towers. Two-way LEFT-HAND traffic, right-hand-drive original sedans, appropriate lane markings, kerbs, drains, bollards. 15-20 varied adult pedestrians naturally dispersed, ordinary city life. Late afternoon warm directional tropical sunlight, soft humid aerial perspective, believable contact shadows and global illumination, physically detailed plaster/asphalt/fabric/glass/metal/skin, restrained saturation and bloom, excellent near/mid/far compositional depth. Camera is a plausible playable view with navigable sidewalk, legible routes, no giant cinematic close-up, no aerial shot, no isometric toy city. Highest-quality modeled silhouettes and environmental detail, no low-poly blocks, no flat untextured buildings, no poster art or brush strokes. No weapons firing or gore. No text overlays, no watermark, no HUD, no concept-sheet borders. Render the single image.
prompts.drive: Create one original photoreal AAA real-time open-world GAMEPLAY CONCEPT image, landscape 16:9, highest-quality physically based rendering. The supplied image is a supporting art-direction reference of OUR Singapore district: preserve its late-afternoon warm tropical light, muted turquoise/coral/ivory shophouses, red-truss hawker market, broad rain trees, cream HDB-inspired blocks and distant glass waterfront skyline. Make a new camera view, not a collage or a crop. Extremely detailed believable architecture and surfaces, subtle atmospheric perspective, plausible scale and working spatial layout. This is an aspirational game concept, no existing franchise logos/characters. No title, watermark, HUD or poster borders. No stylized blocky/low-poly/flat-colour assets. Scene: third-person driving gameplay camera, slightly elevated chase camera directly behind an original deep petrol-blue unbranded four-door sports sedan, whole car clearly visible lower centre, driving AWAY on the LEFT lane of a Singapore two-way road. Oncoming cars face the camera in the RIGHT lane. White centre line and correct left-hand traffic. Steering wheel and driver on vehicle's right side. Street curves gently along a planted canal toward a small bridge and glass waterfront towers. Shophouse arcades and hawker market on the left, residential void decks/sheltered paths and tall tropical trees to right. A distant original police sedan with small red-blue lights follows at a junction, subtle pursuit suggestion but normal traffic still operates. Pedestrians on sidewalks, believable kerbs/drains/lamp posts, textured road, restrained reflections on metallic paint, visible tire rubber and detailed lights/window interiors. Keep the camera similar to a playable open-world driving view, not advertising closeup. Cars are dimensionally correct and roads navigable.
